title: Distributed Resource Theory of Entanglement and Magic
summary: In distributed fault-tolerant quantum computing, entanglement and magic are essential resources for quantum communication and universal fault-tolerant computation, respectively. Although they are usually treated as distinct resource currencies, whether they admit a unified resource-theoretic description remains an open question. Here, we introduce the distributed resource theory of entanglement and magic (DREAM). In this framework, the free states are convex mixtures of product local stabilizer states, and the free operations are local stabilizer circuits assisted by classical communication…
